title: Anyone have a good 3D animation workflow?
author: BladenBranch
selftext:
Hey everyone been trying to get some combat animations done in opus 5.5 but my god is it utterly useless. Seems to get about 30% there but just doesn’t understand how hands are suppose to hold things and can’t even recognize when arms are completely crossed to hold an item etc…

I figured I would just buy the animations I need but I specifically need melee combat with several different weapon types and animation packs seem to not cover all that I need or are purchase able for one specific weapon. 

Just trying to figure out if anyone has cracked the code for animating 3D with AI or if it’s just not something that can be done yet. I’ve tried authored animations as well as procedural and also hybrid. Doesn’t seem to work in any of these cases for me.

comments.author: eljop
comments.body: You can try opus 5.5 max with blender mcp and give video from the desired animation in context but asset packs work better for me

replies.author: BladenBranch
replies.body: Yeah I’m really leaning towards buying more asset packs to use. Just wish there was one that covered all I need that wasn’t 500 dollars lol

comments.author: PushDeep9980
comments.body: Are you using blender or are you using unity/unreal/godot to key your animations.

replies.author: BladenBranch
replies.body: Using blender MCP and Babylon.js as Unity has been pissing me off on my other game lol

replies.author: PushDeep9980
replies.body: Have you tried feeding Claude reference video as YouTube links?  I use codex and this has worked for me in the past.But also, if your at all technical, there are many “video to mocap”open source libraries that exist and you can do some of this yourself. Will probably be a lot of fun actually. Or you could rig your characters to mixamo and get their free animations and have Claude modify them.  I do vr for work, and something I had to do recently was make hand poses for a bunch of grocery store objects, I used a sdk tool from meta for recording live poses, I was talking with my bot about repurposing it, and making custom grab poses for my npcs and it said yes this is do able with some reworking of the tool so if your feeling like getting creative you could rig something like that up to got some pixel perfect weapon placements. Seems like a lot of work though and you might be better served learning how to do some of these fine detail things the way god intended but that’s just where the short comings of ai development are at the moment.

replies.author: BladenBranch
replies.body: I have but it tells me it can’t watch videos? I may try out the mocap
